description: Non-sensitive ChemEng, control theory, numerical methods, and technical reference links for Yggdrasil.

references.title: Internal model control: PID controller design
references.abstract_or_notes: Foundational derivation of IMC-PID tuning laws for first-order plus dead-time (FOPDT) chemical process models using first-order Pade dead-time approximation.

references.title: Simple analytic rules for model reduction and PID controller tuning
references.abstract_or_notes: SIMC tuning rule setting Kc = tau / (Kp * (tau_c + theta)) and tau_I = min(tau, 4 * (tau_c + theta)) for balanced disturbance rejection and robustness.

references.title: Optimum Settings for Automatic Controllers
references.abstract_or_notes: Classical quarter-decay-ratio open-loop reaction curve PID tuning formulas based on FOPDT process gain, time constant, and dead time.

references.title: Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook: Reaction Kinetics, Arrhenius Law & Fluid Flow (Reynolds Number)
references.abstract_or_notes: Standard reference values for ideal gas constant R = 8.314462618 J/(mol*K), laminar-to-turbulent pipe flow transition Re in [2100, 4000], and Antoine vapor-pressure correlations.

references.title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
references.abstract_or_notes: Okapi BM25 ranking formulation with term-frequency saturation parameter k1 = 1.5 and document length normalization b = 0.75.
